fix: (1) Record per-phase fill telemetry alongside the existing token usage: prompt tokens at dispatch as a fraction of the model's effective window (a per-family constant, conservative — e.g. 200K for 1M-advertised). (2) Emit a WARN past a policy-configured fill threshold (default 60%) naming the phase and the largest contributors. (3) Correlate: a small report over the dossier corpus joining fill% at dispatch against the cycle's verdict — that is the evidence that promotes or demotes the whole tokenopt band. Config in policy.json (never Go literals); no flags.
notes: From the 2026-07-30 LLM-stability review §3. Reframes the tokenopt band from COST to QUALITY: every digest item removes low-signal tokens from a phase's window, and distraction is the likeliest explanation for late-phase agents reasoning from accumulated history rather than the diff. | [RESEARCH UPDATE 2026-08-03] Concrete 2026 implementables: Claude Code context buffer ~33K (16.5% of 200K), auto-compaction fires ~83.5% fill, CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE tunes the trigger; server-side compaction is the recommended long-agent strategy; 'compaction thrashing' (refill-immediately-after-compact) is the named failure mode to detect in fill telemetry. Field report (Sikkema 2026-04): deliberately SHRINKING to 200K beat the 1M window for reliability — direct support for this item's cap-the-effective-window half. Wire fill% into phase telemetry first (measurement-first), then set the compact threshold per-phase. | 2026-08-15 batch-20260815c: cycle-1478 worked this item to audit WARN with a REAL 43-file/+3699 build (context-fill cap work) — cycle ended in the verdict-incoherence halt (root-caused to the sentinel parser, FIXED PR #468; NOT a defect in this item's work). Worktree+branch cycle-42824668-1478 PRESERVED — SALVAGE that build before fresh dispatch; audit WARN M1 was posthoc-unresolved (see posthoc-diff-anchor-no-op-cycle 0.8), not a product defect.
summary: Across 18 frontier models, accuracy drops 30-50% WELL BEFORE the documented context limit; failure modes are poisoning, distraction (leaning on accumulated history instead of re-deriving) and confusion. 2026 defaults: budget by FILL PERCENTAGE, compact proactively past ~60%, cap the effective window below the advertised one. We measure tokens SPENT but never how FULL a phase's window was when it produced its deliverable — so we cannot correlate deliverable quality with fill, which is the one experiment that settles how much the queued digest work actually buys.
title: Context FILL telemetry + effective-window cap — context rot is a quality lever, and we cannot currently see it
